note: Released from the Holiday Creator Features experiment in 1.19.50. Pairs with the custom geometry component so creators can author bespoke collision shapes.
note2: Supports an array of collision boxes (for multi-part collision shapes) and a maximum collision box height of 24 units (up from 16). Available without the Upcoming Creator Features experiment and without the format_version 1.21.130 requirement starting in 1.26.0.
description: Defines the area of the block that collides with entities. If set to true, default values are used (a full 16x16x16 block). If set to false, the block's collision with entities is disabled, allowing entities to pass through. If this component is omitted, default values are used.

fields.title: Using a Voxel Shape
fields.description: Currently only available with the VoxelShape experiment on. When using the minecraft namespace, the only currently available collision shapes are: "minecraft:empty" or "minecraft:unit_cube". When using no namespaces or a custom one, the names must start and end with an alpha-numeric character.

fields.title: Using Custom Boxes
fields.description: An array of boxes that define the area of the block that collides with entities.

subForm.description: An array of boxes that define the area of the block that collides with entities.

fields.title: Max
fields.description: Maximum position of the bounds of the collision box. "max" is specified as [x, y, z] and must be in the range (0, 0, 0) to (16, 24, 16), inclusive.

fields.title: Min
fields.description: Minimal position of the bounds of the collision box. "min" is specified as [x, y, z] and must be in the range (0, 0, 0) to (16, 24, 16), inclusive.
